component.name: Sonde Predict
component.summary: Predict radiosonde flight paths and landing points

description.p: Sonde Predict calculates where a weather balloon's radiosonde will land, using upper-air wind forecasts (MET Norway's MEPS in the Nordic area, global models elsewhere), so radiosonde hunters can tell whether a launch is worth chasing. Predictions are shown on a map or in a built-in 3D view and can be exported to GPS and phone apps (GPX).
Better winds and a flight model checked against real flights:

ul.li: MET Norway's MEPS (2.5 km, 65 model levels) averaged with ECMWF in the Nordic area; ECMWF elsewhere
Balloon defaults, ascent shape and descent fitted to hundreds of SondeHub flights
Typical values for 320 launch sites, with measured descents for 22 stations
A landing area that includes forecast uncertainty, calibrated on real landings
Batches over several launch sites, each with its own launch times and balloon
Activity log, profile of several flights, update check
